value.rationale: Entropy and the fair Bernoulli isomorphism erase Euclidean embedding information, but signed-position covariance retains it. A precise rate 2^(-n) with explicit nonzero polynomial second-order tail records the polynomial-gap geometry, and the full covariance recovers all gaps (not the map outside the Cantor set). This is a natural quantitative mixing and inverse observable classification for an infinite physically meaningful expanding-map family, not an unmotivated finite enumeration.
